capabilityItems.heading: # dsh-plugin-guard
capabilityItems.excerpt: Install safety net for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh): pre-install snapshots, one-click / automatic rollback, guarded boot, and incident reports that auto-trigger agent analysis.

capabilityItems.heading: ### How it detects problems (important to understand)
capabilityItems.excerpt: 1. **Snapshots are pure file copies.** Taking a snapshot just copies 5 config files (`package.json`, `pnpm-lock.yaml`, `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, `cordis.yml`, `cordis.patch.yml`). No plugin is run, no behavior is evaluated.

capabilityItems.heading: ### How it detects problems (important to understand)
capabilityItems.excerpt: If a plugin breaks boot — load error, startup crash, unresponsive server — the check fails, and the guard automatically kills the tree, rolls back to the last good snapshot, and retries once.

capabilityItems.heading: ### How it detects problems (important to understand)
capabilityItems.excerpt: the boot-guard diagnoses the offending plugin from the boot logs, **quarantines it** (appends `disabled: true` to `cordis.patch.yml`), boots without it

capabilityItems.heading: ### How it detects problems (important to understand)
capabilityItems.excerpt: `dsh_rollback action=incident` builds a problem-localization report (last boot logs, server stderr, and a diff of the profile config against the last good snapshot) and sets a pending marker
